sources: Romanian Ministry of National Defence announcement Oct 27, via Reuters (Bucharest, Oct 27); corroborated by Moldova1 Oct 30, EU Today, Army Recognition, Balkan Business News Oct 30
fault_line: Should NATO escort merchant ships in the Black Sea, or would escorts drag the alliance into direct war with Russia?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- deployment] France temporarily relocated an Atlantique 2 maritime patrol aircraft to Mihail Kogalniceanu air base, Romania, on Oct 18, to conduct surveillance over the western Black Sea until Nov 6, at Romania's request, to identify navigation dangers and protect critical energy infrastructure in Romania's exclusive economic zone. [VERIFIED FACT -- toll, Reuters-reported] At least 8 cargo ships were hit near the coasts of NATO members Romania and Bulgaria in the three weeks before Oct 27, with some 34 sailors reported dead or missing. [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- shootdowns] Romanian F-16 pilots shot down two latest-generation Russian drones over Romanian territorial waters earlier in October; NATO said it would send more patrol aircraft, radar systems and drones to the Black Sea. [CONTEXT, SOCIAL ONLY -- NOT tiered] Social reels Oct 29-31 report the Contship Jet container ship sunk off Bulgaria after a sea-drone attack, described as a ninth October vessel; attacker attribution in those reels is contested in their own comments and is NOT adopted here.
sections.what_verified: Reuters (T1) + Romanian MoD primary (T1, state RO) = 2 independent publisher families for the deployment fact. Straits Times / SRN / radio-syndication copies of the same Reuters wire count as the Reuters family only. Moldova1, EU Today, Army Recognition, Balkan Business News are relays of the MoD announcement / Reuters wire, not additional families.
sections.what_disputed: Attacker attribution for the cargo-ship strikes is contested: social-reel narration blames Russia, which denies involvement (per the reels themselves); Reuters' Oct 27 account does not attribute the 8 ship strikes to a named actor in the retrieved text. The 8-ship / 34-sailor figures are dated Oct 27 and predate the Oct 29 Contship Jet sinking reported socially, so '8' is a floor as of Oct 27, not a current total.
sections.why_matters: NATO's Black Sea shipping war, counted: 8 cargo ships hit in 3 weeks, 34 sailors dead or missing — and now a French spy plane hunting the threat until Nov 6. The fault line is escort-or-war.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Reuters Oct 27, surfaced in-window via BytesEU Nov 1 00:14Z relay; absent from Oct 27-31 scans) -- France's Atlantique 2 patrol aircraft deployed to Romania for western Black Sea surveillance until Nov 6, after at least 8 cargo ships hit near NATO coasts

totw_analysis: Our read: NATO's Black Sea shipping war, counted: 8 cargo ships hit in 3 weeks, 34 sailors dead or missing — and now a French spy plane hunting the threat until Nov 6. The fault line is escort-or-war. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Should NATO escort merchant ships in the Black Sea, or would escorts drag the alliance into direct war with Russia?
